It gives the opening brace that reads array items and the colon that reads a word definition and stores it in the current vocabulary. challenge.method: Read both exact intervals alongside adjacent §2.3 and §2.3.2, checking literal versus parsing-word classification and the paper’s separate macro mechanism.
challenge.results: The delimiters named in the proposition serve explicitly described parsing operations. The next section treats macros independently, and the additional accumulator example confirms a parser-stage operation.

limitations: The examples are specific to the 2010 account of array and definition syntax. Broader macro equivalence and later implementation behavior require separate evidence.
